phase7_disposition.decision: Deferred, NOT unlocked. The operator initially asked to 'unlock the Phase 7 gate by default' on the grounds that the MSCA budget is trivial (a single funding figure entered on the Funding & Tenders Portal, with no cost breakdown or WP-specific calculation).
phase7_disposition.why_no_unlock_was_made: The premise is already satisfied by design, so no unlock is needed. selected_call.json declares budget_regime='unit_cost'. gate_09 therefore evaluates ONLY its unit-cost branch (g08_uc01/uc02/uc03): that the deterministic unit_cost_budget_deriver (Claude-free, §17.5.3/C2) wrote a resolved unit_cost_budget.json = confirmed_months x published_rates x host_country_coefficient. No Lump Sum Budget Planner response, no cost breakdown, and no WP-specific calculation are required for a unit-cost instrument. This IS the trivial budget path the operator described; C1 introduced it precisely for MSCA.
phase7_disposition.why_a_blanket_unlock_was_refused: A default 'gate always passes' would be a §13.7 gate-weakening. gate_09 is mandatory and bypass_prohibited; its categorical, unconditional, instrument-INDEPENDENT block on Phase 8 was preserved verbatim by the C1 amendment. A blanket unlock would also strip the anti-fabrication guarantee for LUMP-SUM instruments, where a fabricated budget is exactly what the system exists to prevent. Weakening it would require an explicit §14 constitutional amendment by human instruction; it may not be done as a silent default flip by an agent (§14.1, §14.5, §13.7). The operator did not instruct such an amendment.
phase7_disposition.when_resumed: After the quota reset, run Phase 7 with the standard command. Expected to pass cheaply: the deriver is Claude-free and only two light skills run in the node (budget-interface-validation, gate-enforcement). WATCH: g08_uc03 (unit_cost_budget_resolved) requires the published MSCA unit-rate table to be present in Tier 2B; the host-country coefficient input (HU, via the synthetic spine) is already available.

phase8_disposition.token_cost_note: Phase 8 is the most token-intensive phase (decomposed drafting across Excellence/Impact/Implementation, assembly, evaluator review, revision). Deferral also protects the weekly quota, but the constitutional basis above is the primary and sufficient reason.
